title: InstrumentsResponseV1
description: One row per coinids manifest entry, in manifest order. The computable signals are copied from the selector's own scan row (plus the depth overlay); option greeks, observed expiry and days-to-maturity have no source yet and are null, named once in unavailable[]. A row the scan cannot price is still present with priced=false and a reason.

as_of.description: The read moment, ISO-8601 with seconds in UTC.

region.description: The scanned population the stock entries were priced against.

scan.description: How the universe was answered: the scan cache's hit/miss, or skipped when no entry needed pricing. A failed scan is a 503 error envelope, never this document.

universe_total.description: Rows in the scanned universe; null when the scan was skipped.

signals.description: The row cells that are real numbers when a row is priced.

unavailable.description: Every signal this deployment cannot compute, with its reason.

present.description: False when the file is absent: an empty manifest, not an error.

legacy.description: True when the owner's flat {id: symbol} form was read.

expiry.description: ISO date declared by the manifest.

id.description: The owner's label; null when the entry has none.

contract.description: The manifest's declared contract terms for an option row; null for a stock. This is configuration, not an observation.

priced.description: True iff the scan answered a last price for this row. An individual signal cell can still be null when the provider sent no value; an unpriced row carries no other cells.

reason.description: Why the row is unpriced; null when priced.

price.description: The scan's own cell, or null when the provider sent none.

change_pct.description: The scan's own cell, or null when the provider sent none.

volume.description: The scan's own cell, or null when the provider sent none.

beta_1y.description: The scan's own cell, or null when the provider sent none.

market_cap_usd.description: The scan's own cell, or null when the provider sent none.

dividend_yield.description: The scan's own cell, or null when the provider sent none.

ret_1m.description: The scan's own cell, or null when the provider sent none.
